paragraphs: Hyman describes a certain man in the days of Rav Ashi who performed acts of sleight of hand (optical illusion); see Sanhedrin 67a.[^1]

notes.text: The complete Davidson Sanhedrin 67a page, twenty-three whole paragraphs, is a bounded nonmatch for Abba of Karna and his reported activity in Rav Ashi’s time. The body therefore explicitly attributes the account to Hyman; its supplied locator is retained. An empty book search is not proof of absence elsewhere, and no printed locator correction, chronology binding, or extra magical narrative is supplied.
